Subject: Clarify demo time across JP/SG/SYD — avoid overnight cutover

Hi Akiko,

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood Inference. Quick note on timing: I want to avoid accidentally booking a slot that crosses the midnight boundary for your team in Tokyo. Some calendar clients will show the local label ("tomorrow") but not the date, which has tripped a couple of prospects.

Two quick options that work for our APAC engineers:
- Option A (late evening same day): 23:30 SGT / 00:30 JST (next day) / 01:30 AEST (next day) — this is late for JP/AU so only if you prefer after-hours.
- Option B (local morning): 09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 11:00 AEST — my preferred option to avoid cutovers.

I attached a small ICS bundle with both options (gardentech-demo-ics-options.ics) and a short one-pager on the demo flow (redwood-demo-guide.pdf). Can you confirm which time you prefer and which date (e.g., Tue Jun 29 vs Wed Jun 30) to avoid any next-day confusion? If mornings work for you, I’ll have Ava send a calendar invite with explicit TZIDs so all clients show the same absolute time.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: gardentech-demo-ics-options.ics (calendar options), redwood-demo-guide.pdf (one-pager)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for flagging — yes, the late-evening option is tricky because 23:30 SGT becomes 00:30 in Tokyo the next day and that will not work for our ops team.

Option B (09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 11:00 AEST) looks much better for us. Could we aim for 09:00 SGT on Wed, Jun 30? That way Vivian (based in SG) and the Tokyo team can both join during business hours.

Also: please include the date in the invite body — we've had folks accept invites that say "tomorrow 09:00" and then the date gets swapped by calendars using UTC/locale translations. If you can send an invite that explicitly states "Wed, Jun 30 — 09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 11:00 AEST" and attach the ICS with TZID blocks, that will avoid confusion.

Best regards,
Akiko Sato
Senior Product Manager, GardenTech
akiko.sato@gardentech.jp

Thanks — short turnaround on this so the prospect can finalize headcount.
